name: Kellivane Link
text: Wire connector. Sits on the face of a block. Take FE from a generator beside it, hold up to 6 copper wires, and feed any machine beside it. Wires reach 16 blocks and lose 1.5% of the FE per block.

name: Kellivane Spool
text: Wire for copper connectors. Use it on one connector, then on a second one within 16 blocks. Carries 256 FE per tick. Sneak and use to clear the start.

name: Ostrimeth Link
text: Wire connector. Sits on the face of a block. Take FE from a generator beside it, hold up to 6 electrum wires, and feed any machine beside it. Wires reach 24 blocks and lose 0.8% of the FE per block.

name: Ostrimeth Spool
text: Wire for electrum connectors. Use it on one connector, then on a second one within 24 blocks. Carries 1024 FE per tick. Sneak and use to clear the start.

name: Varkhulon Link
text: Wire connector. Sits on the face of a block. Take FE from a generator beside it, hold up to 6 steel wires, and feed any machine beside it. Wires reach 32 blocks and lose 0.4% of the FE per block.

name: Varkhulon Spool
text: Wire for steel connectors. Use it on one connector, then on a second one within 32 blocks. Carries 4096 FE per tick. Sneak and use to clear the start.

name: Tunwiq
text: Hand crank. Use it with an empty hand to turn it for one second. A dynamo beside it turns the torque into FE.

name: Aelvenhorn
text: Windmill. Needs a mostly open 5 by 5 frame around it, facing the way the block faces. Gives more torque higher up and in rain. A dynamo beside it makes FE.

name: Sholmarra
text: Water wheel. Gives torque for each side that touches flowing water. A dynamo beside it makes FE.

name: Zephrikon
text: Dynamo. Turns the torque of hand cranks, windmills and water wheels beside it into FE and pushes it into connectors or machines beside it.

name: Gruvandel
text: Crusher. Feed it ore and FE from a wire and it grinds the ore to dust, sometimes with a bonus item. Has a GUI, FE bar, redstone control and per-face side config.

name: Vorthazek
text: Arc furnace. Smelts dust and raw ore to ingots fast, makes steel from iron and coal dust, and electrum from gold and copper. Slag comes out as a bonus. Needs FE from a wire.

name: Dravokel Engine
text: Diesel generator. Right-click with fuel canisters (up to 4 of one kind). Diesel gives 80 FE per tick for 60 s, biodiesel 60 FE per tick for 50 s. Pushes FE into connectors or machines beside it.

name: Dravokel Canister
text: Fuel canister made from 2 coke and a glass bottle. 80 FE per tick for 60 s in a diesel generator.

name: Eshlovane Canister
text: Fuel canister made from 4 wheat seeds and a glass bottle. 60 FE per tick for 50 s in a diesel generator.

name: Mirkelath
text: Coke oven. Bakes coal into coke, sometimes with coal dust, using a little FE. Coke feeds steel making and diesel.

name: Thurnakel
text: Blast furnace. Needs sheetmetal above and on its left, right and back. Turns 2 iron and 1 coke into 2 steel, or iron ore and coke into 2 iron, with FE.

name: Kellivane Shifter
text: Tier transformer. Takes FE from any side but its front and hands it to the block in front at up to 256 FE per tick, losing 5%. Put it between connectors of different tiers.

name: Ostrimeth Shifter
text: Tier transformer. Takes FE from any side but its front and hands it to the block in front at up to 1024 FE per tick, losing 5%. Put it between connectors of different tiers.

name: Varkhulon Shifter
text: Tier transformer. Takes FE from any side but its front and hands it to the block in front at up to 4096 FE per tick, losing 5%. Put it between connectors of different tiers.

name: Plynthar Sheet (Iron)
text: Plain iron sheetmetal block for building.

name: Plynthar Sheet (Copper)
text: Plain copper sheetmetal block for building.

name: Plynthar Sheet (Steel)
text: Plain steel sheetmetal block for building.

name: Plynthar Sheet (Electrum)
text: Plain electrum sheetmetal block for building.

name: Strandel Scaffold (Iron)
text: Open iron scaffolding. Climbable, and light passes through it.

name: Strandel Scaffold (Steel)
text: Open steel scaffolding. Climbable, and light passes through it.

name: Iron Dust
text: Ground iron ore. Smelt it or put it in the arc furnace to get an ingot.

name: Copper Dust
text: Ground copper ore. Smelt it or put it in the arc furnace to get an ingot.

name: Gold Dust
text: Ground gold ore. Smelt it or put it in the arc furnace to get an ingot.

name: Coal Dust
text: Ground coal. Arc furnace additive for making steel.

name: Coke
text: Baked coal from the coke oven. Used in the blast furnace and for diesel canisters.

name: Slag
text: Waste from the arc furnace. Good for nothing yet.

name: Electrum Ingot
text: Alloy of gold and copper from the arc furnace. Used for electrum wire and connectors.

name: Steel Ingot
text: Iron hardened with coal dust in the arc furnace. Used for steel wire and connectors.

name: Varnoqith Augment
text: Augment. Put up to 4 in a machine's augment slot: each adds 50% speed for a little extra FE per job.

name: Thremuvael Augment
text: Augment. Put up to 4 in a machine's augment slot: each cuts the FE cost of a job by 15%.

name: Ostrivaen Augment
text: Augment. Put up to 4 in a machine's augment slot: each raises the chance of bonus outputs by half again.
